requirements.requirement: The release, branch, source SHA, evidence SHA and tag roles shall be machine-readable and non-ambiguous.
requirements.acceptance: Exact baseline and clean-state record; no historical evidence is presented as current.

requirements.requirement: Package version, documentation status and future tag contract shall agree before release review.
requirements.acceptance: Version contract passes without claiming publication before publication.

requirements.requirement: Public capability records shall be unique at element, analysis, material and route granularity.
requirements.acceptance: No duplicate, orphan or source-unregistered public combination.

requirements.requirement: Each descriptor shall declare topology, DOFs, faces, quadrature, loads and compatible routes.
requirements.acceptance: A supported combination is accepted and an unsupported combination is rejected explicitly.

requirements.requirement: The new V&V harness shall execute declared cases without arbitrary commands or changes to old numerical routes.
requirements.acceptance: Fixture replay, manifest, digest and failure classification are deterministic.

requirements.requirement: A C3D6/PENTA6 oracle shall be classified for availability and formulation comparability before WEDGE6 implementation.
requirements.acceptance: Comparable, unavailable and non-comparable states are explicit and reproducible.

requirements.requirement: Mesh quality shall retain Jacobian, orientation, volume, distortion and conditioning diagnostics where available.
requirements.acceptance: Invalid and near-invalid meshes fail closed; no universal aspect-ratio cutoff is inferred.

requirements.requirement: The Terra-reviewed WEDGE6 formulation shall be implemented and verified for the declared elemental small-strain elastic scope.
requirements.acceptance: Shape functions, Jacobian certificate, full-integration stiffness, strain/stress recovery, rank, rigid-body, affine, load-state, distortion and replay checks pass; user workflow, faces, loads, mixed meshes and external correlation remain deferred.

requirements.requirement: The WEDGE6 static vertical slice shall cover import, assembly, boundary faces, loads, reactions and post-processing.
requirements.acceptance: 15 declared static cases pass their predeclared checks with reproducible artifacts; one invalid geometry case is an expected fail-closed result. WEDGE6 remains experimental and public qualification is deferred.

requirements.requirement: WEDGE6 robustness evidence shall cover quality, distortion, orientation, failure paths and comparable external observables.
requirements.acceptance: Unexplained divergence blocks promotion; unavailable or incompatible external runs remain explicit.

requirements.requirement: WEDGE6 modal maturity shall be established independently from static maturity.
requirements.acceptance: Consistent mass, finite positive frequencies, eigenpair residual, mass orthogonality, deterministic replay and a four-level refinement are recorded; the first three modes satisfy the predeclared final-change rule, and comparable six-mode Code_Aster frequency/MAC evidence is bounded to four same-mesh PENTA6 cases. Static evidence is not transferred.

requirements.requirement: Existing small-strain J2 evidence gaps shall be addressed across the already supported solid families without changing formulation.
requirements.acceptance: Tangent, increment characterization, rollback, energy and failure evidence are bounded and traceable; no new universal increment threshold or maturity promotion is implied.
requirements.limitations: Small-strain J2 remains qualified only within the existing bounded four-family scope; increment sensitivity is characterized without a universal structural independence claim; finite-kinematic J2 remains experimental/not qualified.

requirements.requirement: Large-model readiness shall report time, memory, nnz, residual and topology at declared size levels.
requirements.acceptance: Each size receives a bounded verdict; resource limitation is characterized rather than mislabeled as success. Matrix-free completion is demonstrated through 750141 DOF, 300k assembly is separately recorded, and the 1M attempt is explicitly resource-limited.
requirements.limitations: Owner closeout is pending; results are bounded to the generated structured TET4 linear-static topology and measured hardware/software environment.

requirements.requirement: Research/stretch work shall be selected by explicit Owner decision and shall not enter the core claim transitively.
requirements.acceptance: Each selected experiment has a bounded result or explicit non-qualification.

requirements.requirement: A 0.2.7 release candidate shall have coherent public documentation, package artifacts, regression evidence and Owner scope.
requirements.acceptance: No stale claim, missing evidence head, package drift or unclassified public capability remains.

level_up_requirements.acceptance: Release truth and golden numerical baseline have distinct SHA roles and reproducible digests.
The large-scale execution contract freezes a real TET4 model, true DOF target, resource context, solver/SPD rules, replay and evidence requirements without marketing claims.
Matrix-free TET4 matches an assembled subscale reference with explicit SPD and preconditioner evidence.
A complete reproducible iterative solve is demonstrated on at least 1000000 real FEM DOF with residual, equilibrium, energy and two replays.
level_up_requirements.owner_decision: PASS: two independent PETSc CG/GAMG replays satisfy the unchanged WP14 acceptance metrics at 1,029,000 true DOF.

level_up_requirements.acceptance: PETSc/MPI availability, backend selection and reproducibility are explicit; unavailable environments remain non-PASS.
level_up_requirements.owner_decision: PASS_WITH_LIMITATIONS: pinned PETSc 3.25.1 / MPICH 5.0.1 CG+GAMG is reproducible and explicit; two-replay 1M and 3M Silver evidence pass under unchanged WP14 criteria. PETSc remains optional at runtime; host availability and AIJ memory remain explicit limitations.

level_up_requirements.acceptance: Bronze, Silver and Gold are distinct; Silver is a reproducible full 3M solve and Bronze alone creates no solve claim.
level_up_requirements.owner_decision: PASS_WITH_LIMITATIONS: Bronze and Silver passed on the declared structured TET4 PETSc/MPI route; Gold remains NOT_ATTEMPTED because restart/checkpoint and a distinct second physical case were not run.
limitations: AIJ peak RSS is approximately 10.08 GB at 3M DOF on the recorded two-rank container

level_up_requirements.acceptance: Adversarial paths are fail-closed and HEX8 behavior is diagnosed without unreviewed formulation promotion.
level_up_requirements.owner_decision: PASS_WITH_LIMITATIONS: bounded adversarial evidence is fail-closed and deterministic; compatible C3D8 displacement correlation supports a low-order diagnostic only; no HEX8 formulation is promoted.
limitations: 24 predeclared adversarial cases do not establish universal robustness
C3D8 external reactions and energy are NOT_COMPARABLE
Euler is diagnostic only; no universal HEX8 accuracy claim
HEX8R/SRI/B-bar was not evaluated or promoted

level_up_requirements.acceptance: Residual J2 gaps are characterized on the existing bounded scope; controlled comparable constitutive evidence is reused without post-result tolerance retuning, while no universal structural increment claim is made.
Architecture, API and registry cleanup is surgical and preserves legacy routes and public imports.
Final release checks reconcile claims, evidence, registry, package and regression results at a declared checkpoint.
level_up_requirements.owner_decision: PASS_WITH_LIMITATIONS: Owner qualification is complete at 100 percent; stable release metadata and bounded limitations are recorded.

level_up_2_requirements.requirement: Performance evidence shall be phase-separated, deterministic and provenance-backed.
level_up_2_requirements.acceptance: Setup, operator, preconditioner, solve, communication, post and resource observations use declared units, source/configuration/input/output digests and stable field names.

level_up_2_requirements.requirement: The CPU/MPI/PETSc/KSP/PC configuration and resource budgets shall be frozen before large execution.
level_up_2_requirements.acceptance: Backend selection is explicit, unavailable backends fail closed, and no post-result retuning is accepted.
level_up_2_requirements.owner_policy: OWNER_APPROVED_BOUNDED_SINGLE_HOST_MPI_V2; unmeasured phase fields remain explicit limitations

level_up_2_requirements.requirement: 3M Gold shall add a materially distinct 3M FEM workload to the existing Silver evidence.
level_up_2_requirements.acceptance: The second workload passes two replays with residual, equilibrium, energy, finite-output, resource and provenance checks under the frozen route; the claim remains bounded.
limitations: Structured TET4 homogeneous isotropic linear-static FEM only.
Pinned single-host Docker/PETSc/MPI configuration only; preflight, redistribution, communication and I/O are NOT_MEASURED.
No universal, multi-node, GPU, mixed-mesh, nonlinear or restart claim.

level_up_2_requirements.requirement: 5M Bronze shall demonstrate real FEM construction and distributed operator/preconditioner readiness without a solve claim.
level_up_2_requirements.acceptance: Two deterministic constructions agree on DOF, partition, ownership and digest and remain under predeclared setup/resource budgets.
level_up_2_requirements.decision: PASS: corrected frozen 5M TET4 Bronze route completed matrix assembly, RHS, PCSETUP, global PC_READY, all-rank post-ready synchronization, raw evidence and clean finalization without a converged-solve claim.

level_up_2_requirements.requirement: 5M Silver shall be a complete, reproducible solve under a frozen MPI configuration.
level_up_2_requirements.acceptance: Bronze passes first; two solve replays satisfy residual, equilibrium, energy, finite-output, RAM and no-retuning criteria.
level_up_2_requirements.decision: PASS: two complete converged replays of the exact 5M TET4 linear-static workload satisfy the frozen residual, equilibrium, energy and finite-result criteria without retuning.
limitations: Claim is bounded to the recorded single-host PETSc 3.25.1 / MPICH 5.0.1, 8-rank CG/GAMG route.
No universal, multi-node, GPU, mixed-mesh, nonlinear, restart or Gold claim.

level_up_2_requirements.requirement: Execution recovery, retries and diagnostics shall be explicit and fail closed.
level_up_2_requirements.acceptance: Timeout, memory, convergence, backend and recovery outcomes cannot silently become PASS, and state integrity is proven where mutable state exists.
level_up_2_requirements.owner_decision: PASS_WITH_LIMITATIONS: additive lifecycle and diagnostics are installed; recovery claims remain limited to existing targeted routes.
limitations: No universal execution graph, timeout recovery, distributed recovery or fault-tolerance claim.
Linear, buckling, harmonic, geometric nonlinear and large distributed routes remain non-recoverable under this contract.

level_up_2_requirements.requirement: Only existing route gaps capable of changing a public maturity decision shall receive targeted V&V.
level_up_2_requirements.acceptance: Evidence is selected before execution and qualification remains non-transitive across elements, analyses, materials and backends.
level_up_2_requirements.owner_decision: PASS_WITH_LIMITATIONS: existing route maturity is defensible at the documented element/analysis/material/backend scope; no promotion or demotion is made.
limitations: Qualification remains non-transitive across element, analysis, material and backend routes.
Finite-kinematic J2, coupled nonlinear routes, friction, mixed meshes, HEX8 next-generation formulations and untested large-route recovery remain outside qualified claims.
External evidence remains bounded and family-specific; no universal external validation claim is made.

level_up_2_requirements.requirement: Mixed meshes and candidate new-solid or HEX8 routes shall receive explicit bounded decisions before implementation.
level_up_2_requirements.acceptance: Deferred and experimental routes are not exposed as qualified capabilities and feature decisions are supported by risk/evidence records.
level_up_2_requirements.owner_decision: PASS_WITH_LIMITATIONS: no new element or production HEX8 formulation is promoted; deferred and research routes remain outside the active qualified registry.

level_up_2_requirements.requirement: The final LU2 decision shall reconcile claims, registry, evidence, CI, package and provenance.
level_up_2_requirements.acceptance: A declared Owner checkpoint chooses RELEASE or NEW_LEVEL_UP; no release is automatic and no unclassified blocker remains.
level_up_2_requirements.owner_decision: PASS_WITH_LIMITATIONS: Owner qualification is complete at 100 percent; stable release freeze and bounded limitations are recorded in Step 1.
